summary: The target always has exactly twelve scoring sections, so subset enumeration has a fixed 4,096-mask domain and no legal scalable section-count axis.

workload_bound.source_constraint: aliceArrows and bobArrows always have length 12, representing sections 0 through 11

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference visits exactly 4,096 masks and inspects at most twelve section bits per mask, independent of numArrows.
Regression compares returned scores with an independent exhaustive affordable-subset oracle across deterministic fixtures and randomized legal allocations.
